scope: Only original study_v1 and common-start retry native evidence. Other project studies/CPU continuation are not counted.
criteria: Historical policy achievement, stricter historical study pass, preparation success and known-angle diagnostic are different claims.
Historical sources/results are preserved. No historical success is inherited into the new 336-case denominator.
Recorded checkpoint SHA is indexed but checkpoint contents are not loaded or recomputed here. Raw report and episodes SHA are computed.
Geometric loaded-pad success is not calibrated string pressure, vibration or acoustic success.
